proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface type UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord has no magic_item variant. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom and the survey corpus includes many magic items (tier 2), but the TypeScript surface has never been widened to accept a magic item record shape. No honest encoding is possible without a new top-level record kind.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Cubic Gate is kind: magic_item. UnitRecord does not include a MagicItemRecord branch.

proposed_widenings.name: charge_recharge_daily_dice
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. The existing UseCountResource + RestResetCadence only models rest-based fixed refills. This requires a new recharge cadence variant: daily-at-dawn with a dice-valued refill amount.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The cube has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: cast_named_spell_via_charge
proposed_widenings.justification: Each of the two item modes (Gate, Plane Shift) works by expending a charge to cast a named spell. The surface has no shape for 'consume charge → cast spell by reference'. The v4 atom inventory has stored_spell (attachment) and grant_spell_access (effect) but neither is wired into an item-activation mechanics family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can expend 1 of the cube's charges to cast one of the following spells using the cube. Gate. [...] Plane Shift. [...]

proposed_widenings.name: plane_keyed_side_selection
proposed_widenings.justification: The six faces are each keyed to a different plane determined by the GM. The portal or shift destination is the plane keyed to the pressed side. This is a DM-agenda assignment at item creation time, but the mechanical consequence (transport to that plane) is a deterministic effect. A closed atom for plane-of-existence target would be needed, or this is classified as caller-owned metadata.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence [...] The other sides are linked to planes determined by the GM.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: magic_item is not a UnitRecord variant. All secondary blockers (dice-valued daily recharge, spell-by-reference casting, plane-keyed selection) are downstream of the missing kind. The plane-keying is partially DM-agenda (which planes) but the transport effect itself is deterministic, so this is not purely dm_agenda — it has real mechanical content that belongs in core once the kind exists.
